method.agentQuery: The agent query is the first 6 words of the question with at least 4 letters or digits, lowercased, in question order, punctuation dropped, in the question's language (the stage-2 rule); latest_user_message is the question. The blind bank uses its query as written.
method.arms: A: searchDocsRanked with the shipped keyword candidates. B:<model>: searchDocsRanked with docsEmbeddingSearch(<model>) (hybrid candidates, 500 ms query-embedding deadline, fallback to A's candidates). C:<model>: embedding top 20 only, re-ranked by the same Jev spec, returned in the product's excerpt format, keyword output on a Jev failure (diagnostic). Jev deadline 800 ms everywhere.
method.design: 3 runs; per item and run every arm runs back to back in an order shuffled with seed 20260928; items and runs in 4 concurrent workers. Section indexes are built before timing starts.
method.answer: Primary: the tool's text output (excerpts, or the keyword snippet on fallback) is judged against the gold fact by google/gemini-3-flash on Vertex (thinking low, ZDR, no training, temperature 0, reference-fact prompt); only yes passes.
method.rightSection: Secondary: a returned section (the up to 3 re-ranked sections, or the keyword best section on fallback) is a gold anchor or an alternative; rightFirst checks only the first, lenient and strict; pageFirst checks the first section's page.
method.stats: Per item and arm, the majority of 3 runs; exact two-sided sign test on discordant items against A, Holm over the two models per arm family; mean difference with a 95% item-cluster paired bootstrap (10000 resamples) over all runs, paired by item and run; Wilson 95% intervals.
method.latency: search_docs wall time per call; added p95 is p95(B) minus p95(A) over all calls, with a 95% item-cluster bootstrap interval of that difference.
method.gate: Per B model: pooled majority answer difference >= +5 pts, Holm sign-test p < 0.05, each language >= -5 pts, added p95 <= 300 ms.
